description: Change audio clips' volume by a number of decibels (Clip > Audio Options > Increase or Decrease Clip Volume; the Audio Clip Mixer's and Properties panel's volume), scaling every Level keyframe when the volume is animated, and set their pan or balance (the Panner's Balance, or Pan). Volume and pan are one undo step, keyframe interpolation a second

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

gainDb.description: Raise (positive) or lower (negative) the Volume Level by this many dB

pan.description: Panner Balance (stereo clips) or Pan (mono): -100 full left, 0 centre, 100 full right, as Effect Controls shows it

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

name: adjust_clip_audio
title: Adjust Clip Audio
